description: Source code for etcd's internal client key-value API, including definitions for API methods, request/response handling, error types, and URL construction.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error response from the etcd API with code, message, cause, and index.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response from the etcd key-value API, including action, node, previous node, index, and cluster ID.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a key-value node in etcd, including key, value, children, creation/modification indices, expiration, and TTL.

classes.name: httpKeysAPI
classes.description: Implementation of KeysAPI interface using HTTP client.

classes.name: httpWatcher
classes.description: Implementation of Watcher interface for HTTP-based watching.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Creates or updates a key-value node in etcd with specified options.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new key-value node only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: CreateInOrder
methods.description: Atomically creates in-order keys within a directory.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value node, optionally recursively.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves nodes from etcd based on key and options.

methods.name: Watcher
methods.description: Creates a watcher for a specific key with options.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Blocks until an etcd event occurs, then returns the response.
